title: Prepare initial crystal structures
action: Construct crystal structures for the five C3P4 phases (α, β, cubic, pseudocubic, graphitic) by substituting P for N in known C3N4 polymorph structures. Save as DFT input files.
description: Creates initial geometry inputs from C3N4 analogues.

title: Compute total energy vs. volume for each C3P4 phase
action: Run DFT total energy calculations for each C3P4 phase over a range of volumes around equilibrium (uniform scaling). Write volume and total energy per C3P4 unit to CSV.
description: Raw energy-volume data used to extract equilibrium properties.
output_schema: CSV columns: phase (str), volume_ang3 (float, cubic Angstrom per C3P4 unit), total_energy_eV (float).

title: Extract equilibrium properties by E(V) fitting
action: Fit the energy-volume data for each phase to a 4th-order polynomial, determine equilibrium volume, total energy, and bulk modulus. Write the fitted properties to CSV.
description: Equilibrium total energy, volume, and bulk modulus from polynomial fit.
output_schema: CSV columns: phase (str), equilibrium_energy_eV (float), equilibrium_volume_ang3 (float), bulk_modulus_GPa (float).
